summary: Frontend-only E2E (Playwright, 390x844 / 360x640 / 1920x1080) of iteration_4 features on the preview URL. PASSED: starter screen (chip filters + search + filters-reset, face grid, inspector version-<id> buttons, add-<id>, 3-slot dock showing name + TEAM e.g. 'Jude Sharp / Royal Academy', segmented difficulty, start button no overlap at 390 and 360px, full-roster notice); title perks-btn/savecode-btn; Perks screen (balance, 9 category tabs with counts, free Comune I, costs 20/45 deducted correctly, disabled when unaffordable, fusion inazumabreak locked until tiro III + scatto III then 400, persistence); start-run perk offer (3 normals + optional cursed, confirm count, cassa +100 money applied, quaderno +3 levels, skip); HUD hud-perk chips + banner toggle; checkpoint flow boss-intro -> battle -> consequence -> perk-offer -> reward -> Act 2 intro; end-of-run spirit (+88 lose at W21 with Ray Dark = 70*1.25, +235 W50 win, meta updated); save code export/copy (clipboard matches)/invalid msg/confirm dialog/import restores meta+run; Mixi Max anomaly (variant label, pick, win, reward-notice, run.mixi, meta.forms, team card -mixi-donor + -mixi-info, Collection entry); spirit cut-in full-screen 'Gran Majin' ~1.7s then battle continues; regressions (W50 journey act5 checkpoint passed, skipped anomaly not counted, swap hint shows team display name, '1 TURNO' singular). Jest: 114 pass / 2 fail (same as baseline). FOUND 2 real bugs: Mixi Max donor-role passive never resolves (always +10% VEL) and negative HP perks (Ray Dark) permanently shrink current HP after every battle (compounding). Plus a crash when importing a save code with a partial meta.

ui_bugs.issue: PASSIVES is keyed FW/MF/DF/GK but catalog roles are A/C/D/P (data.js ROLES), so mixiPassive() always falls back to MF (+10% VEL). Verified in UI: Torch (role 'A', attacker) gave 'Mixi Max · aura di Torch (+10% VEL)' and not +10% ATK. ATK/DIF/HP passives can never happen.

Runtime HP scaling leaks back into the saved HP. With Patto di Ray Dark I (-15% HP), a battle where the team took no damage (DEF+5000) returned the team at 92/108, 67/79, 65/77. The next battle scales it down again (92*0.85...), so the penalty stacks on every match. RCA: in battle hp = round(hp*scaledMax/max), but on the way out it only does hp = min(clean.maxHp, battleHp) and never undoes the scaling. Positive hpPct (mano, muraglia, Mixi GK) gets the opposite skew.

An import code with v:1 and a partial meta (e.g. {teamSpirit:5}) passes decodeSave and is given to updateMeta as-is. TitleScreen then crashes: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)'. A reload fixes it because loadMeta normalizes. The imported meta should go through the same defaults + migrateCollection as loadMeta (and the run through validation) before setMeta.

issues: A fusion perk (Inazuma Break) is offered and can be stacked while its own components (Tiro Potente III) are already active, e.g. Tiro +10% plus Inazuma Break +12% ATK. The 'occupa un unico posto' copy suggests the fusion should replace or exclude its components.
Cursed cards read 'Maledetto · Maledetto' because the rarity and the category share the label.
Redundant text: 'Hai già Jude Sharp (Royal) (Royal Academy)'. The player name already includes the version tag.
Long names are cut with an ellipsis ('Nathan S…') at 360px width. Acceptable, but 390px is the minimum where names show in full.
The banner sits in the HUD's normal flow, so opening it pushes the map down instead of overlaying it (minor).

action_items: Fix mixi.js PASSIVES keys to the catalog roles: A -> atkPct, C -> spdPct, D -> defPct, P -> hpPct (and add a unit test with an attacker donor).

Make perk/Mixi HP scaling runtime-only: when leaving battle (win, flee, lose), convert battle HP back with hp = round(battleHp * clean.maxHp / battleMaxHp), or keep a separate unscaled HP, so Ray Dark does not drain HP after every match.
Normalize imported save data in the SaveCodeScreen onImport path (meta defaults + migrateCollection, the same as loadMeta) to avoid the TitleScreen crash.
Optional: exclude or replace fusion components when a fusion perk is active; deduplicate the 'Maledetto · Maledetto' label; drop the duplicate version tag in the swap hint.
critical_code_review_comments: mixi.js: role key mismatch (FW/MF/DF/GK vs A/C/D/P). This is a silent fallback with no test coverage.
BattleScreen.jsx L182-185 and L296: recalcStats strips stat buffs, but HP is not rescaled when hpPct perks or Mixi GK are active.

applyPerkBuffs writes critBonus onto player objects. Because it ends up in st.team, it is persisted into run.team after battle (harmless now, since it is overwritten each battle, but it leaks a runtime field into saved data).
App.onConsequence calls updateMeta twice in a row from the same stale meta (unlockStarter then recruitVersion(unlockStarter(meta))). It works today but is fragile; prefer the functional setMeta.
perkOffer computes the offer and only then checks MAX_ACTIVE_PERKS. Fine, but the order could be simpler.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work; 2 logic bugs + 1 import crash)

seed_data_creation: None. Only browser localStorage in ephemeral Playwright sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call is a fresh browser. Setup: localStorage.clear -> optionally set inazuma_rogue_meta.perks/teamSpirit/collection (e.g. 'jude:royal':{starterUnlocked:true}) -> reload -> new-run-btn -> add-<id> -> start-run-btn. Abandon is inside details-btn (Diario) panel, then abandon-btn (confirm dialog). Map anomaly position varies with the run. Reliable approach: loop waves 11-29 (contentSeed=1, path=[], completedWave=w-1, introSeen=act), reload + continue-run-btn, look for map-node-*:not([disabled])[aria-label*='Anomalia temporale'] (found W24/W26 in act 3). A team without Mark/Axel (nathan/jack/kevin) forces the Mixi variant. The W10 boss node id is map-node-act1:boss:royal and W50 is map-node-act5:boss:allstars. To verify fixes: (1) Mixi with an attacker donor (Torch) should show +10% ATK; (2) with Ray Dark and an undamaged win, HP should stay 108/108.
rca of the issue: Mixi: PASSIVES lookup uses resolveVersion(id).role, which returns 'A'/'C'/'D'/'P', and the keys don't match, so it always falls back to MF. HP leak: applyPerkBuffs/applyMixiBuffs scale hp into a different maxHp space, and the battle exit paths only clamp to clean.maxHp without rescaling, so the scaled HP gets persisted. Repro: unlock raydark, pick it at run start, give the team DEF+5000, win W1, then read run.team hp (92/108). Import crash: craft base64 {v:1, meta:{teamSpirit:5}, run:null}, then Codice salvataggio -> Carica: TitleScreen throws.
